sample_scope: One fixed 11-page paper, 20 fixed development questions, one retained observed result per case. Mixed learner-reported and instrumented live runs. This is a learning/development baseline, not an independent held-out generalization estimate.
retrieval_definition: Full support for every required fact, allowing semantically equivalent evidence. Multi-part questions count only if all parts are supported. Unanswerable cases are excluded from retrieval denominators.
citation_definition: Among valid displayed answers with nonempty evidence, whether the quotes come from retrieved text and support the answer; empty or unavailable citations are not counted as successes.
review_method: Assistant semantic inspection with local PDF and saved candidates; no additional model grading calls.
